title: Externally Valid Selection of Experimental Sites via the k-Median Problem
abstract: arXiv:2408.09187v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a decision-theoretic justification for viewing the question of how to best choose where to experiment in order to optimize external validity as a $k$-median problem, a popular problem in computer science and operations research. In particular, when treatment effect heterogeneity across experimental and policy-relevant sites is substantial (in a sense we make precise), we present conditions under which minimizing the worst-case, welfare-based regret among all nonrandom schemes that select $k$ sites to experiment is equivalent to solving a $k$-median problem. The connection costs in the relevant $k$-median problem are given by ex-ante bounds on worst-case voltage effects between sites, and minimizing the sum of worst-case voltage effects can be cast as a linear integer program. Two empirical applications illustrate the theoretical and computational benefits of the suggested procedure.

translated_title: 通过k-中位数问题实现外部有效的实验地点选择
translated_abstract: 我们从决策理论的角度提出论证，将如何最优选择实验地点以优化外部有效性的问题视为一个k-中位数问题——这是计算机科学和运筹学中的一个经典问题。具体而言，当实验地点与政策相关地点之间的处理效应异质性显著时（我们给出了精确的界定），我们提出了相应的条件，在这些条件下，在所有选择k个实验地点的非随机方案中最小化最坏情况下的基于福利的后悔值，等价于求解一个k-中位数问题。该k-中位数问题中的连接成本由地点之间最坏情况电压效应的事前界限给出，而最小化最坏情况电压效应之和可以表述为一个线性整数规划问题。两个实证应用展示了所提方法在理论和计算上的优势。
tldr: 该论文从决策理论角度证明，在处理效应异质性显著的条件下，为优化外部有效性而选择k个实验地点以最小化最坏情况福利后悔值的问题，等价于求解一个k-中位数问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a decision-theoretic justification that, under substantial treatment effect heterogeneity, selecting k experimental sites to optimize external validity by minimizing worst-case welfare-based regret is equivalent to solving a k-median problem.
